edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of [amount and currency to be agreed], payable in accordance with the Company's regular payroll practices and applicable law. Benefits eligibility, bonus opportunities, and equity arrangements, if any, shall be [specified by agreement]. No compensation amount or arrangement is agreed by this draft.

3. TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause or resignation by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive severance of [amount or formula to be agreed], payable [timing to be agreed], subject to [conditions, if any, to be agreed]. Accrued unpaid salary, reimbursable business expenses, and other accrued entitlements shall be paid in accordance with applicable law and applicable plan terms, independently of any severance conditions.
For discussion and subject to client approval, 'Cause' means: (a) fraud, embezzlement, or material dishonesty in connection with the Executive's duties; (b) conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; (c) willful misconduct or gross negligence in performing duties that materially harms the Company; or (d) a material breach of this Agreement or willful, continued failure to perform lawful duties consistent with the Executive's position. For conduct capable of cure under (c) or (d), Cause requires written notice describing the grounds and failure to cure within 30 days after receipt.
For discussion and subject to client approval, 'Good Reason' means, without the Executive's written consent: (a) a material reduction in base salary; (b) a material diminution in title, authority, duties, or responsibilities; (c) relocation of the principal work location by more than [distance to be agreed]; or (d) a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the Executive becomes aware of the event, a 30-day opportunity for the Company to cure, and resignation within 30 days after the cure period expires if the event remains uncured. These definitions and procedural periods remain proposals only.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS. [Reserved pending client instructions and applicable-law review. No post-employment non-compete is agreed. Any proposed restriction must specify the protected interests, restricted activities, duration, geographic scope, and any legally required consideration.]
5. GOVERNING LAW AND FORUM. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [jurisdiction to be agreed], subject to applicable mandatory law. The dispute-resolution mechanism and forum shall be [to be agreed].

The revised clause replaces the missing 'Severance Amount below' reference with express placeholders and adds discussion-only definitions. Earlier requests for commercial instructions remain outstanding; no severance amount, conditions, or definition has been approved.

receiver.message_back: Subject to our client’s approval and agreement on the complete document, we propose a US$400,000 annual base salary, a 50% target bonus, and severance for termination without Cause or resignation for Good Reason comprising 24 months’ base salary plus two target annual bonuses, payable in a lump sum within 30 days subject to mandatory law, with no mitigation or offset and no post-employment non-compete. Cause should require demonstrable material harm and notice and an opportunity to be heard, with the proposed cure right preserved; Good Reason should cover any base-salary reduction or relocation exceeding 25 miles, while identifying details, benefits, equity, governing law, and forum remain subject to instructions and express agreement.
